brief:
Author Akbar Shahid Ahmed interviewed over 150 officials for his latest book examining the Biden administration's approach to Gaza, according to Zeteo. The account reveals what the author characterizes as significant failures in how the administration handled the conflict.

Ahmed's research draws on extensive conversations with government insiders to document the administration's decision-making process regarding Gaza policy during the period covered in the book.
dek: Author Akbar Shahid Ahmed spoke to more than 150 officials to expose the Biden administration’s failures on Gaza in his latest book - and what he reveals to Mehdi should shock and outrage you.
title: Biden administration deprioritized Palestinian suffering in Gaza policy, new book finds
